Original pending/skip declarations remain visible.

Every runnable source identity has a completed timing in the comparison or a documented separate profile. Historical272unknownobservations remain unknown. TestFlight failures and originalpendingintegrationdeclarations remain explicit. Timings use native reporter precision and include per-case fixtures where stated.

Each phase partition reconciles to its measured command. Setup/cleanup, compilation outside execution, nested and parallel timings, model concurrency and image-import overlap are labelled. Residual elapsed time is not claimed as CPU work or a diagnosed cause.

Frozen source hashes rechecked; cohorts retain source/fixture differences, failures and historical gaps. No estate-wide total or optimization credit is inferred from separate profiles. Evicted ephemeral raw logs are explicitly unavailable; previously imported results and independent hashes remain embedded.
